newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria cenbank to switch repo period on Jan 10.
newsitem.headline: Austria cenbank to switch repo period on Jan 10.

text.p: Austria's central bank said on Friday it would switch to offering two-week securities repurchase agreements on January 10, correcting an earlier statement in which it said it would switch to 14-day repos on January 17.
The central bank so far has usually offered seven-day repos to the banking system on a week-by-week basis.
In a statment, the bank said the switch was made to comply with standards adopted in most other European countries. -- Vienna newsroom +4312 53112 274
